catalysts.headline: Private placement closed: ~$30.8M gross proceeds (~$29.0M net) at closing; accompanying warrants (exercise price $6.10/ADS) could bring total gross proceeds to ~$50.0M if fully exercised. Company states net proceeds, assuming full warrant exercise, are expected to fund operations into H2 2029.
